title: The Effectiveness of Video-capsule Endoscopy in Gastrointestinal Bleeding of Obscure Origin
brief_summary: The study objective is to compare the cost-effectiveness of VCE to push enteroscopy in patients with gastrointestinal bleeding of obscure origin with a negative initial work-up.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years old
* Normal gastroscopy, colonoscopy and small bowel follow through in the last 3 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Demonstrable source of blood outside the GI tract
* Significant cardiopulmonary disease
* Suspicion of strictures or fistulae of the GI tract
* Pregnancy
* Numerous small intestinal diverticula
* Zenker's diverticulum
* Extensive Crohn's enteritis
